steps.title: Dashboard — current market regime
steps.narration: The dashboard opens with the live market regime score. The market is currently reading Risk-on at 76.05, and a direct link invites you to see which certified claims are proven within this regime.
steps.point_out: The 'Risk-on 76.05' regime indicator and the 'See evidence proven in this regime →' link below it

steps.title: Regime-conditioned evidence — certified claims for this regime
steps.narration: Following the regime link opens the evidence ledger showing claims that passed their out-of-sample test specifically in this market regime. The Breakout-watch claim is labeled 'Regime: Risk-on' with a holdout edge of +6.12%, clearing the significance threshold.
steps.point_out: The second claim row — 'PASS Breakout-watch setup [Regime: Risk-on]' — with its OOS holdout edge and p-value of 0.0004998

target.name: See evidence proven in this regime →

steps.title: Evidence ledger round-trip — back to the stock leaderboard
steps.narration: Each certified claim carries a link back to the surface it backs. Clicking 'Backs: Stocks leaderboard →' returns directly to the stock rankings, completing the two-way traceability loop from a score, to its proof, and back again.
steps.point_out: The stocks leaderboard with 120 rows, each showing a grade, a score, and an evidence badge — 'Proven' for Leadership, 'Not yet proven' for Entry Quality and Risk

steps.title: Stock detail — honest badge mix on MU
steps.narration: Opening the Micron Technology detail page shows the three signal scores side by side. Leadership is the only score marked 'Proven' because it is the only one backed by a passing certified claim. Entry Quality and Risk openly show 'Not yet proven', keeping the picture honest.
steps.point_out: Leadership A 94.58 marked 'Proven' alongside Entry Quality 23.66 and Risk 53.11 both marked 'Not yet proven'

steps.title: Proof drill-down — expanded out-of-sample panel
steps.narration: The 'Why proven?' button expands the full statistical backstory: a sealed holdout cohort of 12,297 observations, an out-of-sample edge of +6.36% beating SPY, p = 0.0004998, and the certified-claim registration date — everything needed to verify the score is not in-sample fit.
steps.point_out: The proof panel showing the OOS PASS verdict, holdout edge +6.36%, p = 0.0004998, cohort size 12,297, and the 'View backing evidence row →' link
